fact: The Minister of State, Economy and Finance said the new Sydonia introduced real-time electronic payments with direct integration with national banks, for customs revenue.

The Autoridade Geral Aduaneira says electronic payment of customs declarations through participating banks, using a 20-digit reference, entered operation on 1 September 2026, with electronic channels mandatory from 1 October 2026.
